<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ws_operation"><sys_ws_operation action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><consumes/><consumes_customized>false</consumes_customized><default_operation_uri/><enforce_acl/><http_method>POST</http_method><name>Submit Request</name><operation_script><![CDATA[(function process(/*RESTAPIRequest*/ request, /*RESTAPIResponse*/ response) {

    // 1. อ่านข้อมูล JSON payload ที่ระบบภายนอกส่งเข้ามา (หัวใจข้อสอบ CAD: request.body.data)
    var requestData = request.body.data;
    
    // 2. สร้าง Record ใหม่ลงในตาราง Equipment Request ด้วย GlideRecord
    var grReq = new GlideRecord('x_2266883_employ_0_equipment_request');
    grReq.initialize();
    
    // กำหนดค่าเริ่มต้น
    grReq.setValue('requested_for', gs.getUserID());
    grReq.setValue('justification', requestData.justification || 'Created via External Scripted REST API');
    grReq.setValue('state', '1'); // 1 = Draft
    
    // ค้นหาสินค้าจากชื่อ หรือ sys_id ที่ส่งมา
    if (requestData.item) {
        var grItem = new GlideRecord('x_2266883_employ_0_equipment_item');
        if (grItem.get('name', requestData.item) || grItem.get(requestData.item)) {
            grReq.setValue('item', grItem.getUniqueValue());
        }
    }
    
    var newSysId = grReq.insert();
    
    // 3. กำหนด HTTP Status Code เป็น 201 Created (สร้างข้อมูลสำเร็จ)
    response.setStatus(201);
    
    // 4. ส่ง Custom JSON Response กลับไปให้ระบบภายนอก
    return {
        "status": "success",
        "message": "Equipment Request created successfully via REST API",
        "sys_id": newSysId,
        "number": grReq.getValue('number')
    };

})(request, response);]]></operation_script><operation_uri/><produces/><produces_customized>false</produces_customized><relative_path>/request</relative_path><request_example/><requires_acl_authorization>true</requires_acl_authorization><requires_authentication>true</requires_authentication><requires_snc_internal_role>true</requires_snc_internal_role><short_description/><support_trailing_slash>false</support_trailing_slash><sys_class_name>sys_ws_operation</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-17 09:18:12</sys_created_on><sys_id>ac51da20c3c4d3104435ddec0501319f</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Submit Request</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Employee Equipment Request" source="x_2266883_employ_0">8bb7b4e4c3c893104435ddec050131f5</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Employee Equipment Request">8bb7b4e4c3c893104435ddec050131f5</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ws_operation_ac51da20c3c4d3104435ddec0501319f</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-17 09:18:12</sys_updated_on><web_service_definition/><web_service_version/></sys_ws_operation></record_update>
